verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-retention settings, retention periods, or deletion or purge controls in GrowthBook. Related points do not count as retention or deletion controls: targeting attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook, the platform can be self-hosted, and it runs warehouse-native on the customer's own data. Stale-flag cleanup concerns feature flags, not user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
